_note: Downloads for the hand-pose samples whose sample pack is released under a passcode. Written by scripts/samples/handpose/stage-handpose-packs.mjs --upload, which also puts the objects in GCS, so an entry here is an object that exists. Merged into the download manifest only where hand pose is published (src/lib/samples/downloads.ts). Every entry has all three keys: preview (the pack zip), metadata (the sample metadata JSON) and full (delivered by signed link after the licence is agreed, so its object stays null).
